title: Same Luck, Different Choice: Twin-World Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning rewards a complete episode, yet the policy needs credit for every decision inside it. Counterfactual branching estimates this credit by re-running the episode after an alternative decision, but the branch draws its sampling noise independently of the factual episode, so the outcome difference mixes the effect of the decision with the luck of everything that follows. We observe that in agentic search the retriever, the corpus, and the grader are deterministic, so an episode is a deterministic function of the policy's decisions and its sampling noise. Twin worlds are therefore realizable: the same noise, a different decision. We introduce TWICE (TWIn-world Credit Estimation), which keys the Gumbel noise of every token by turn and line, rolls out counterfactual twins that inherit the factual episode's downstream noise, and turns their paired outcome differences into turn-level advantages for policy-gradient up

translated_title: 相同的运气，不同的选择：面向智能体强化学习的孪生世界信用分配
translated_abstract: 智能体强化学习对整个回合给予奖励，但策略需要为其内部的每一个决策获得信用。反事实分支方法通过在做出替代决策后重新运行回合来估计这一信用，但该分支的采样噪声是独立于事实回合抽取的，因此结果差异混合了决策的真实效果与后续所有环节的运气。我们观察到，在智能体搜索中，检索器、语料库和评分器都是确定性的，因此一个回合是策略决策及其采样噪声的确定性函数。因此，孪生世界是可以实现的：相同的噪声，不同的决策。我们提出了TWICE（孪生世界信用估计，TWIn-world Credit Estimation），它按回合和行对每个token的Gumbel噪声进行键控，推出继承事实回合下游噪声的反事实孪生回合，并将配对的结果差异转化为回合级优势，用于策略梯度更新。
tldr: 提出TWICE方法，通过让反事实孪生回合继承事实回合的采样噪声（即“相同运气、不同选择”），将配对结果差异转化为回合级优势，从而在智能体强化学习中对每个决策实现更准确的信用分配。
en_tdlr: TWICE proposes twin-world counterfactual rollouts that inherit the factual episode's downstream sampling noise, isolating the true effect of each decision from downstream luck to provide accurate turn-level credit assignment for agentic reinforcement learning.
